events.continuity_hook: The Kansas City installation trip is complete, allowing Avery to turn to the couple's longer coastal vacation for the year.
events.interaction_goal: Compare viable flight schedules and well-rated coastal lodging in both destinations, estimate the combined transportation and eight-night room totals, and identify which island offers the stronger practical itinerary for the fixed dates.
events.scenario_brief: Avery and her wife begin planning an eight-night late-May coastal vacation and are choosing between San Juan and St. Thomas. Their dates are fixed from Saturday through the following Sunday, they need round-trip travel from Atlanta for two adults and one shared room, and they want to compare actual beach access, recent guest ratings, and complete trip costs before committing to either island.

events.continuity_hook: Selecting St. Thomas narrows the open vacation planning to a specific round trip and lodging search.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the complete round-trip fares for two adults, elapsed travel times, connection details, and usable time on the island, then retain the best nonstop and connecting combinations while Avery confirms one remaining work commitment.
events.scenario_brief: Avery and her wife choose St. Thomas after reviewing the two destination estimates. For the Saturday outbound, they can take an early nonstop or a less expensive one-stop trip arriving late in the afternoon; the Sunday return choices include a midday nonstop and an evening connecting itinerary that preserves more vacation time but reaches Atlanta much later.

events.continuity_hook: The cleared work commitment removes the only obstacle to choosing the faster outbound identified in the flight comparison.
events.interaction_goal: Recheck the selected nonstop flights, confirm the full fare and baggage charges for both travelers, choose available adjacent seats including Avery's window seat, and book the round trip.
events.scenario_brief: Avery's exhibition calendar is cleared for the Friday before departure, so the early Saturday nonstop is now practical. The preferred Sunday midday nonstop remains available, and Avery and her wife want adjacent seats, with a window seat for Avery, before the fare changes.

events.continuity_hook: Confirmed arrival and departure times now fix the exact lodging dates for the couple's stay.
events.interaction_goal: Calculate the complete eight-night totals for the realistic room and rate combinations, compare beach access and transportation needs, inspect recent ratings, and identify a refundable first choice plus a viable alternate.
events.scenario_brief: With the flights booked, Avery and her wife need one room for eight nights in St. Thomas. A beachfront resort offers direct sand access but adds mandatory daily resort and parking charges, while a highly rated hillside property has a lower room total, no direct beach access, and scheduled transport to two beaches; refundable and advance-purchase rates are available at each.

events.continuity_hook: The loss of the original room reopens the lodging choice without affecting the already booked flights or vacation dates.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the ocean-view resort room with the condo-style hotel by full cost, deposit schedule, cancellation deadline, beach access, and recent ratings, then reserve one room for both travelers for all eight nights.
events.scenario_brief: The standard room at the preferred beachfront resort sells out before Avery books it. An ocean-view room there is still available at a higher total, while a newly available condo-style hotel has direct beach access, a kitchenette, and a lower complete price but requires a larger deposit and has an earlier cancellation deadline.

events.continuity_hook: The coastal vacation is fully booked, but the airline schedule change and incomplete arrival record require a coordinated follow-up before travel.
events.interaction_goal: Compare accepting the earlier nonstop with moving to the evening connection, verify the resulting checkout and airport-transfer timing, confirm the selected flight arrangement for both travelers, and add the outbound arrival details to the hotel reservation.
events.scenario_brief: The airline moves the booked Sunday nonstop ninety minutes earlier, leaving less time between hotel checkout and departure but still allowing a normal airport transfer. Avery and her wife can accept the new time at no charge or move to an evening one-stop itinerary; their hotel also needs the arrival time entered on the reservation so it can hold the room for their Saturday check-in.
